keySentence: The best trick is making work feel like play.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Tom was clever, brave, and fun. He made work seem like play. This was his best trick. The best trick is making work feel like play.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Tom Sawyer taught us many important lessons about life. He showed that cleverness can solve problems in surprising ways. He proved that courage matters when truth needs to be told. The best trick is making work feel like play for everyone. When we enjoy what we do, we do it much better. Tom's secret was always seeing fun where others saw boredom.
